title: Gary McKinnon's hack and the tic tac image
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Gary McKinnon's hack and the tic tac image, about 2001 at NASA mission control, Houston, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
he queried the Johnson Space Center
because there were um there was a a UFO
whistleblower named Donna Hair
And McKinnon hacks in and he starts to see a a UFO pop up and populate on his screen. It's a tic-tac UFO and it's orbiting Earth
tellings.difference: Dates it 2002-2003, says the tic-tac was orbiting Earth, and adds Steven Greer and the Disclosure Project book.
tellings.link_reason: Gary McKinnon hacking US networks and seeing a tic-tac UFO image is the same hack-and-image story.

as_told.title: Gary McKinnon hacks US networks and sees a tic-tac UFO
as_told.place_text: UK / US military and NASA networks

tellings.quote: And McKinnon then sees a UFO pop up on his screen. He sees a tic-tac UFO that seems to be orbiting Earth pop up on his screen.
tellings.difference: Describes the tic-tac as seeming to orbit Earth and places it in Building 8, 2001-2002.
tellings.link_reason: Same story of Gary McKinnon's hack of the Johnson Space Center systems and the tic-tac image appearing on his screen.

as_told.title: Gary McKinnon sees tic-tac UFO in NASA system
as_told.place_text: NASA Johnson Space Center Building 8, Houston
